title: virea incana
intro: Virea incana, commonly known as Wood Betony, is a flowering plant native to Europe and Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as a mild sedative. The health benefits of Virea incana include reducing anxiety and stress, improving sleep quality, and alleviating menstrual cramps. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, such as borneol and borneol acetate.
